name: Ollama + Open WebUI
summary: Run open AI models on your own computer with a ChatGPT-style interface. Use the Local AI advisor to pick a model that fits your RAM.
gains: Private: chats stay on your computer
Upload documents and chat with them
Can also plug in a pay-as-you-go API for hard tasks
tradeoffs: Local models are a step below the newest paid models
Speed and quality depend on your RAM/GPU
Open WebUI install uses Docker or Python
setupSteps: Open a terminal and run the model the Local AI advisor recommends, e.g. `ollama run qwen3:8b`
Install Open WebUI (`pip install open-webui` then `open-webui serve`, or the Docker one-liner from their README)
Open http://localhost:8080 in your browser and create your local account
Pick your model in the dropdown and start chatting
commercialNote: Ollama is MIT. Open WebUI's license asks you to keep its branding; removing it for a larger deployment requires an enterprise license.
